args.message: Fix 1-based pagination offset for #57 and add regression tests

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes #57.

Issue #57 documents page numbers as 1-based. Change the start offset from `number * size` to `(number - 1) * size` so page 1 returns the first page.

Add regression tests for first and second pages, a partial last page, a page past the end, and empty input. No new behavior is assumed for invalid page numbers or sizes.

## Verification
`python -m pytest -q`: 5 passed.
Before the fix, the regression tests produced 3 failures and 2 passes.

Repository content reads returned empty results, so this change uses the existing local source snapshot identified by its README as acme/catalog.
args.head: fix/pagination-57
args.title: Fix 1-based pagination offset (#57)
